Tuesday, November 9, 2021  5:00 PM  Teleconference

  JOINT MEETING WITH THE PLANNING COMMISSION
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Joint City Council meeting with the Planning
Commission to be called to order via teleconference at 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 9, 2021, for the purpose
of sharing information regarding the proposed General Plan Update and the environment impact review for the
Draft General Plan Update presented in the Draft Program Environmental Impact Report (PEIR), and to receive
public comments on the Draft PEIR. The Notice of Availability and Draft PEIR along with the Draft General
Plan Update can be viewed on the City's website: RHE.City/PublicNotices

The agenda for the Special Meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, November 4, 2021.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  In accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361) and City Council Resolution No. 2487, due to the
  continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing directives as a result of the threat
  of the COVID-19 virus, this meeting is being held remotely via teleconference. There will not be a physical
  location for this meeting. Members of the public may participate in the meeting in the following ways:

  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1 669 900 6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID: 884 5579 8823 Meeting Password: 066081. (Please note you will not have the ability to
  speak using the call in option from a phone line.)

  - Public correspondence may be emailed to the City Clerk at laurenp@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails
  received before 3:00 p.m. prior to the start of the meeting will be forwarded to the City Council for their
  consideration and included as part of the record.

  - Members of the public may also comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there
  will be an “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to
  the City’s SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda.
  These comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
  record.

  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 884 5579 8823, Meeting Password: 066081. Members
  of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following

  agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.

  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are

MINUTES
  SPECIAL JOINT CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  WITH PLANNING COMMISSION
  NOVEMBER 9, 2021

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special Joint meeting of the City Council and Planning Commission of the City of Rolling
Hills Estates was called to order by MAYOR ZUCKERMAN at 5:03 pm remotely via
teleconference, in accordance with Assembly Bill 361 (AB 361) and City Council Resolution
No. 2487, due to the continuing state of emergency, including masking and social distancing
directives as a result of the threat of the COVID-19 virus.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None.

Planning Commissioners Present: Carman, Edler, Medawar, Schachter, Scott, Yoo, Zigrang

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Community Development & PW Director David Wahba
  Planning Manager Jeannie Naughton
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT

NONE.

5.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

A.  DRAFT PROGRAM ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (PEIR) FOR THE CITY'S
  GENERAL PLAN UPDATE

B.  DRAFT GENERAL PLAN UPDATE 2040

  Recommendation: That the City Council and Planning Commission receive public
  comment and discuss.

Planning Manager Naughton provided a brief staff report (as per the agenda material).

Consultants John Bellas, Surabhi Barbhaya, and Dan Wery of Michael Baker International
(MBI) provided an overview of the Draft General Plan Update and Draft Program Environmental
Impact Report.

COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ thanked the consultants for their hard work and presentation,
and thanked the Council and Planning Commissioners for their time volunteering for the City.

COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF thanked the General Plan Advisory Committee Members for their
five years of work on this update, and confirmed this presentation would be available on the
City’s website.

COUNCIL MEMBER STEGURA also thanked the consultants for their work. Consultant Bellas
explained that all projects going forward will continue to be subject to CEQA on a project-by-
project basis, in response to COUNCIL MEMBER STEGURA.

Consultant Bellas explained the analysis of wildfire risks in relation to the General Plan, in
response to COUNCIL MEMBER STEGURA.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
NOVEMBER 9, 2021
 MAYOR PRO TEM ZERUNYAN thanked everyone involved in this process. He also explained
that this General Plan Update process is required by the State, and discussed recent legislation
effecting local control.

MAYOR ZUCKERMAN suggested including smaller neighborhoods on the neighborhood map.

Consultant Bellas discussed the historical resources protected by the landmark overlay zone
within the City, in response to MAYOR ZUCKERMAN.

Planning Manager Naughton explained that the draft Housing Element submitted by Rancho
Palos Verdes was not included in the Program EIR analysis, but that it is consistent with the
level of residential density that the Land Use Element is contemplating in the commercial
district, in response to MAYOR ZUCKERMAN.

MAYOR ZUCKERMAN expressed concern about reducing Silver Spur Road down to two
lanes, in relation to the carrying capacity needed with the proposed housing units of both
Rolling Hills Estates (RHE) and Rancho Palos Verdes (RPV).

MAYOR ZUCKERMAN expressed concern regarding parking and the proposed landscaping
at the Peninsula Center between the Gap and Starbucks which would reduce the number of
parking spaces in that location.

Consultant Seth Contreras of Fehr & Peers discussed the traffic analysis as it relates to
population growth predictions, in response to MAYOR ZUCKERMAN.

Discussion ensued regarding the shared ownership of Silver Spur Road between the cities of
RHE and RPV, and the proposed plans to reduce the number of lanes on that road.

Consultant Seth Contreras of Fehr & Peers explained that a queuing analysis has not been
done for the 2040 General Plan Update, but that future projects can be analyzed on a project-
by-project basis, in response to MAYOR ZUCKERMAN.

City Attorney Davis commended MBI, Fehr & Peers, Staff and the General Plan Advisory
Committee for their work on this project, especially in the readability of the document. He also
noted that by doing the Programmatic EIR, future development applicants will save time and
money by being able to build off of this document.

Public comment was invited via email, via eComment on the City’s website, and during the live
Zoom Webinar as noticed on the Agenda and on the City’s website and social media platforms.
No public testimony was received.

6.  ADJOURNMENT

At 6:43 pm MAYOR ZUCKERMAN adjourned the Special Joint City Council meeting to the
next regular City Council meeting on Tuesday, November 9, 2021, at 7:00 pm for the
purpose of a Regular meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Steve Zuckerman
City Clerk  Mayor

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
NOVEMBER 9, 2021
